```{=html}
<section class="resources-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="resource-grid">
      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Repositories Overview</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          This page lists all GitHub repositories containing golf biomechanics models, simulations, 
          data processing tools, and related software. Each repository focuses on different aspects 
          of biomechanical modeling, control theory, and golf swing analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3><a href="repositories-3d-model.html">Golf Model (3D)</a></h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          A comprehensive MATLAB-based biomechanical modeling and simulation system for analyzing golf swing dynamics, 
          trajectory optimization, and performance metrics. Includes tools for golf swing biomechanical modeling 
          using MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Multibody, motion capture data analysis, dataset generation, interactive 
          GUI applications, and Python-based utilities for data processing and visualization.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3><a href="repositories-2d-model.html">2D Golf Model</a></h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Two-dimensional golf swing model for simplified analysis and visualization of golf swing dynamics. 
          Provides a streamlined approach to understanding fundamental biomechanical principles with reduced 
          computational complexity.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3><a href="repositories-drake.html">Drake Golf Model</a></h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Golf swing models and simulations implemented using Drake, an open-source toolbox from MIT's Robot 
          Locomotion Group. Focuses on underactuated systems, manipulation, and control-affine dynamics for 
          golf biomechanics analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3><a href="repositories-pinocchio.html">Pinocchio Golf Model</a></h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Rigid body dynamics and kinematics models using Pinocchio for golf swing analysis. Includes 
          forward/inverse dynamics, Jacobian computations, and constraint handling for multibody systems 
          in golf biomechanics.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3><a href="repositories-models.html">Model Repositories</a></h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Collection of additional model repositories including MuJoCo Golf Swing Model, Pendulum Golf Models, 
          and other biomechanical simulation frameworks. These repositories provide physics-based simulations 
          and analysis tools for understanding golf swing dynamics across different modeling platforms.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>MuJoCo Golf Swing Model</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Physics-based golf swing simulations using MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) for biomechanical 
          analysis. Provides fast and accurate physics simulation for model-based optimization and analysis of 
          golf swing dynamics.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Pendulum Golf Models</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Pendulum-based models and simulations that serve as simplified analogs for understanding golf swing 
          dynamics. Includes single, double, and multi-link pendulum systems providing insights into control-affine 
          systems and drift-input decomposition.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Data Processor</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Tools and utilities for processing motion capture data, biomechanical measurements, and golf swing 
          analysis datasets. Includes data cleaning, transformation, and visualization capabilities.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Audio Processor</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Audio processing tools for analyzing sound data related to golf swings, including impact sounds, 
          club dynamics, and acoustic feedback analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Video Processor</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Video processing and analysis tools for golf swing video data, including motion tracking, frame 
          extraction, and video-based biomechanical analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Golf Book</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Repository containing materials, notes, and resources related to golf biomechanics research and 
          publications.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Tools</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          General-purpose tools and utilities for golf biomechanics research, data analysis, and model 
          development workflows.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Unit Converter</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Unit conversion utilities for biomechanical measurements, ensuring consistent units across different 
          analysis tools and models.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Games</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Interactive games and simulations related to golf biomechanics and swing analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Robotics</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Robotics-related projects and tools for robotic systems analysis, control, and simulation relevant 
          to biomechanical modeling.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>ML Projects</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Machine learning projects and tools for analyzing golf swing data, pattern recognition, and predictive 
          modeling in biomechanics.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Project Template</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Template repository for creating new projects with consistent structure, CI/CD workflows, and 
          development best practices.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Repository Management</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Tools and scripts for managing multiple repositories, including automation, CI/CD configuration, 
          and repository maintenance utilities.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
